method.objective: sum(max(0,1-y*margin)^2) for strict rankings + sum(margin^2) for exact ties + existing ridge/partial-pooling penalty
method.contrast: Unlike squared targets, correctly ranked examples incur no ranking penalty once the unit margin is reached; large correct gaps are not pulled back toward 1.
method.constraint_status: Soft penalties, not guaranteed hard constraints. Hard feasibility checked separately; labels not rewritten.
method.evaluation: Same 5 seeds, 5 outer/3 inner withheld-family folds, feature families, alpha/pooling/threshold grids, and balanced-accuracy selection as interaction-comparison.json
method.limitations: Repeated adaptive dataset and iterative model selection; no pristine holdout, no statistical certainty from split ranges. Strength labels remain uncalibrated.
